title: Liria 03 – Stories No One Writes Down
summary: The great library of Novaris was filled with the soft rustle of old pages. Sunbeams streamed through tall windows, painting golden patterns across the stone floor.
story:
The great library of Novaris was filled with the soft rustle of old pages. Sunbeams streamed through tall windows, painting golden patterns across the stone floor.

Liria sat among towering bookshelves, leafing through a chronicle.

"Battles, rulers, great inventions..." she murmured. "But where are all the other stories?"

An elderly archivist looked up from his desk.

"Which stories do you mean?"

"The stories of the people who lived here. The baker who gave away bread during the last bitter winter. Or the craftsman who kept repairing the old bridge."

The archivist smiled wistfully.

"Such things are rarely written down."

Liria closed the heavy book.

"Then we should start!"

She took an empty volume from a shelf and sat beside him.

For hours, the archivist spoke of people whose names had long been forgotten. Liria listened closely, asked questions, and wrote down every detail.

When the evening sun shone through the windows, a new book lay on the table.

On its first page were the words:

The history of a world is made not only of its great deeds, but also of the small kindnesses of its people.

Liria regarded the lines with satisfaction.

Today she had made no great decision and changed no destiny.

But she had ensured that a few stories would not be lost.
